## Root Native UI Fix Gate 40351

Naturally Nx1. Production UI runtime compiled after actual fixed-list correction; Plugin then stopped on 37 actual production/test-feature compiler errors before plane/widget assertions. Root repaired six explicit async context lifetimes, missing value namespace, disjoint source-field borrow, mutable opening registry authority guards, and four new testkit helper type namespaces after this failure. Enduser is repairing whole AcceptanceError, ingress assembled and fixture render; cancellation loan getter is now present in defining Job source. Remaining runtime errors are old calls to mutable source args/fault command APIs and optional response/intent dispatch outputs. Those require retained original input/output on pending, not empty fallback values. Host owns stationary tree ABI and production PatchTracker context calls. Tool-created build-failure.stdout.txt is empty; actual compiler blocks are from merged native log SHA256 ead385c8dfe6ec8022affc3dcf4ff3a11944d92b0e82b92e1c5f5fbb39bd850d. Initial empty stdout extraction was corrected before any native assertion claim.
